visual_review.method: Personally reviewed listed actual GPU frames full-size: continuous walk phase,4sec pause,rotation and same-person restore; boundary0/2/4 include changed tile coverage. Ground projection checks and distance-phase checks passed15 times. Does not certify final animation/art or absence of rare realtime hitches. Video uses actual fixed60fps frames, throughput measured separately.

limits: Button signal to drawing is not physical input/display latency.
Fixed60fps capture is separate from realtime throughput.
Baseline binary not retained; baseline runtime/harness source retained.
Rare50ms+ frames observed and reported, not zero-stutter certification.
